title: Knowlify vs Arcads: Done-for-You Ads or Self-Serve Software
summary: Knowlify vs Arcads compared: done-for-you AI ads with human review versus Arcads' self-serve credits, trial terms and AI actors, as of October 2026.
body_markdown:
## What should a fair test look like?


Run the same script, product and approval rule through both routes before you judge either one. Write one script, choose one product shot and one presenter type, and count the finished minutes you can publish after fixes. A pilot that counts only the first render favors whichever tool produces the nicest first take.


For Arcads, count attempts as well as finished videos, because every new attempt draws on the same allowance. Its[credit plan documentation](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/13230774-how-to-buy-more-credits) lists Starter with 8,000 monthly credits and Creator with 16,000, and says both pause usage at the limit and reset unused credits each cycle. Higher tiers have different rollover and overage arrangements, so check the allowance and the overage rule together before you buy.


For Knowlify, send the same script and ask for a quote that names the finished count, the revision rules and the delivery date. Then compare the two on what you would publish, not on the price of one clip.


## Which AI disclosure and testimonial rules apply?


Meta's[AI information guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/1010479435004531) describes labels for ads created or edited with certain Meta and third-party generative tools, with differences by region. Because the labels apply to ads made with certain tools, ask both providers which tools they use and who checks the labels before launch.


The FTC's[announcement of its final rule](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials) bans fake reviews and testimonials. The FTC's[testimonial rule Q&A](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/consumer-reviews-testimonials-rule-questions-answers) says there is no blanket ban on AI avatars in marketing, but an avatar testimonial is prohibited when the testimonial it delivers is fake or false (as of October 2026). Use AI presenters for brand statements, and keep customer stories tied to real customers.


## When to pick Arcads, and when to pick Knowlify


Pick Arcads if your team will write, generate and edit the ads, has time to test many variants and wants control over each step. Pick Arcads if you prefer credit-based usage and can track credits closely during testing.


Pick Knowlify if you want finished ads delivered, with a person checking each one before it reaches you. Pick Knowlify if you also want the same provider to run the Meta campaigns. Both products use AI presenters, so if the ad needs a real customer or creator on camera, neither is the match.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is a done-for-you agency with about 25 finished ads a week, a person checking each one and plans from $5,000 a month.
- Arcads is self-serve software with 1,000+ AI actors, 74 spoken languages and credit-based plans, so your team does the production.
- Arcads' trial needs a card and converts to Starter unless you cancel within the 72-hour window, so check the renewal terms first.
- Compare the routes on finished ads per month and the hours your team spends, because Arcads' help pages show credits and send you to its app for current prices.


## FAQ


### Is Knowlify a software tool like Arcads?


No. Knowlify is a done-for-you agency, while Arcads is software your team uses to create and launch video ads. The practical difference is who does the production work.


### Can I compare Knowlify and Arcads on price?


Only on the same output. Arcads' help pages show credits and send you to its app for current dollar prices, while Knowlify's plans start at $5,000 a month. Convert Arcads credits into the finished ads you would accept, including editing time, before you compare totals.


### Do either of these make real creator videos?


No. Knowlify does not supply real human creators, and Arcads' talking actors are AI actors based on consented likenesses. If you need real customers or creators on camera, look at a creator agency instead.


### Which should a small team choose?


A team with an editor and time to iterate may do well with Arcads' software. A team without that capacity is more likely to need the finished-ad route that Knowlify sells, with a person checking each ad.
